items.title: AI hiring boom could turn into a surprise tailwind for software: Bernstein
items.summary: Investing.com -- Artificial intelligence could prove a surprise tailwind for software companies if productivity gains spur businesses to hire more workers rather than cut headcount, Bernstein analysts said, challenging one of the sector’s key bearish narratives.

items.title: Self-Driving’s Next Task: Potholes
items.summary: REVIEW  On Monday, shares of Tesla jumped 5.5%, closing at $367.95, up 18% for the month after dropping 26% in July. Why the rise? There were no Wall Street upgrades or price-target changes. One Global exchange-traded fund co-founder Gary Black speculated investors might be anticipating the launch of Cybercab, Tesla’s robo-taxi, which lacks a steering wheel.

items.title: Adobe (ADBE) Shares Climbed, So What Is Catching Attention Now?
items.summary: Adobe (ADBE) has set a clear timeline for its next leadership chapter, naming Anil Chakravarthy as president and future CEO while longtime leader Shantanu Narayen moves to the executive chair role. Adobe shares have been volatile around the leadership news, with a 1-day share price return of 2.13% and a 30-day share price return of 10.98% lifting the stock to US$285.75. However, the 1-year total shareholder return has fallen 17.01% and the 5-year total shareholder return has declined 56.81%...

items.title: Looking Ahead to the Q3 Earnings Season: What to Expect
items.summary: 2026 Q3 earnings for the S&P 500 index are expected to increase by +23% from the same period last year on +11.2% higher revenues, reflecting the 13th consecutive period of growth. Revisions for the period remain positive, a continuation of the trend we've seen over the past year.
